==Standard dialogue==
===First time===
* '''Yama:''' Ah... [player name], welcome. I would offer you some water, but we don't get much of it down here.
* '''Player:''' Thanks...
* '''Yama:''' I take it you have questions.
* {{tselect|Select an option}}
* {{topt|You know why I'm here. Stop messing around.}}
** '''Yama:''' I do, but it is important that it is you who is asking for information, not me that is offering it.
** '''Player:''' Okay... How are you still communicating with your followers?
** {{tact|Continues from "Why, through my voice, of course."}}
* {{topt|I take it you have answers.}}
** '''Player:''' I take it you have answers.
** '''Yama:''' I do, but I rarely share them umprompted.
** '''Player:''' Okay, how are you still communicating with your followers?
** {{tact|Continues from "Why, through my voice, of course."}}
* {{topt|Yes, a few of them actually.}}
** '''Player:''' Yes, a few of them actually. How are you still communicating with your followers?
** '''Yama:''' Why, through my voice, of course.
** '''Player:''' You know what I mean. How are you still communicating with your voice?
** '''Yama:''' The same way I always have.
** '''Player:''' But the dark nullifier... I thought it was supposed to sever your connection.
** '''Yama:''' Hmm... Yes, if anything could have done so, it would have been the power of the Dark Altar.
** '''Yama:''' However, when your opponents have only one angle of approach, it makes them so predictable.
** '''Player:''' You knew we would try to use it?
** '''Yama:''' Yes. When I heard you would be hand delivering me a connection to the Dark Altar... Why, I was overjoyed.
** '''Player:''' But... I remember planting it! The plan went off without a hitch!
** '''Yama:''' I do not doubt that you remember it that way.
** '''Player:''' What did you do?!
** '''Yama:''' A simple transfiguration of the mind. My disciples granted you a memory of success. A fitting payment for your gratious{{Sic}} service.
** {{Tcond|If Icthlarin's Little Helper has been completed:}}
*** '''Player:''' You modified my memory?! That's only the second time someone has done that to me, and I wasn't very happy about it then either!
*** {{tact|continues}}
** {{Tcond|If Icthlarin's Little Helper hasn't been completed:}}
*** '''Player:''' You modified my memory?!
*** {{tact|continues}}
** '''Yama:''' Yes. And I have now answered five of your questions. I believe my generosity has been both demonstrated and exhausted.
** '''Player:''' You call that gloating generosity? If you didn't want something from me, I wouldn't still be down here. Get to the point.
** '''Yama:''' Hmm... Perhaps you are more astute than I thought. Very well, there is something that I want.
** '''Player:''' Well you won't be getting it from me!
** '''Yama:''' I am Yama. Every mortal desires something of mine. Ancient armaments? Hidden knowledge? Or perhaps a taste of revenge...
** '''Yama:''' These things could be yours.
** '''Yama:''' Face me in combat. If you win, you take it all. Armaments, knowledge, revenge.
** '''Player:''' And if I lose?
** '''Yama:''' I take your soul. For all of eternity.
** '''Player:''' No thanks.
** '''Yama:''' I see. Perhaps we could lower the stakes then.
** '''Yama:''' I will face you in an inhibited form. I'll even allow you to bring an ally, provided they have entered the same contract.
** '''Yama:''' If you win, I will give you a chance to gain some of my treasures, and of course, you will have sampled your revenge.
** '''Player:''' And if I lose?
** '''Yama:''' When you take your final rest, I shall take your soul for a year. A drop in the ocean compared to eternity.
** '''Player:''' How can I know you'll keep your word?
** '''Yama:''' The same way I will know you shall keep yours. A binding contract. As luck would have it, I had one of my scribes draft one up for just such an occasion.
** '''Player:''' ...Okay.
** '''Yama:''' Sign right here.
** {{tselect|Sign the contract?}}
** {{topt|Yes.}}
*** {{tselect|{{Colour|#ff0000|Are you sure?}} A contract with Yama cannot be backed out of.}}
*** {{topt|Yes.}}
**** '''Yama:''' Excellent... Challenge me when you are ready, [player name]. I very much look forward to it.
**** {{tact|end}}
*** {{topt|No.}}
**** {{tact|below}}
** {{topt|No.}}
*** '''Player:''' I'm not sure I want to...
*** '''Yama:''' Of course. There is no rush. Leave, with your tail tucked between your legs. If you grow a spine and wish to fulfil your revenge, I will be waiting.
*** {{tact|end}}

===After battle, victorious===
* {{tact|One of the following is said before standard dialogue follows, after which the "In any case" section is played. This can appear as an overhead quote if Yama is challenged, which ignores the "In any case" section.}}
* {{trandom}}
* {{topt|Dialogue 1}}
** '''Yama:''' I hope you are finding the spoils from my treasury to your liking. There are plenty more for you to claim.
* {{topt|Dialogue 2}}
** '''Yama:''' Your victories mount. You are getting better at this.
* {{topt|Dialogue 3}}
** '''Yama:''' A victory earned. But there is room for improvement, is there not?
* {{topt|Dialogue 4}}
** '''Yama:''' Here we go again. I suppose it is entertaining watching you desperately guzzle potions, at the very least.
* {{topt|Dialogue 5}}
** '''Yama:''' I must once again commend your strategy. Employing tactics so boring that they put your opponents to sleep is very novel.
* {{topt|Dialogue 6}}
** '''Yama:''' Back again I see. I can see how you find these bouts exhilarating, being such a feeble opponent.
* {{topt|Dialogue 7}}
** '''Yama:''' Your willingness to wager your soul continues to surprise. I suppose you think of it even less worth than I do.
* {{topt|Dialogue 8}}
** '''Yama:''' Honestly, I expected more. That it takes you as long as it does to defeat my inhibited form is rather embarrassing.
* {{topt|Dialogue 9}}
** '''Yama:''' You look happy with yourself. How endearing.
* {{topt|Dialogue 10}}
** '''Yama:''' You return once more. Excellent.
* {{topt|Dialogue 11}}
** '''Yama:''' Ah, you have returned. Your competence matches only your greed.

* '''Yama:''' In any case, [player name], are you here to challenge me?
* {{tact|above}}

==Standard dialogue (Demonic Pacts League)==
===Initial dialogue===
* '''Yama:''' Make it quick, [player name], I have no appetite for distraction.
* {{tselect|Select an option}}
* {{topt|Why am I here?}}
** '''Player:''' Why am I here?
** '''Yama:''' You are here for a number of reasons, [player name]. Chiefly because I deign to allow these petty games to play out.
** '''Player:''' Petty games? You mean the League?
** '''Yama:''' Yes, {{Colour|#000080|my}} League.
** '''Yama:''' I confess my curiosity has finally won through. Long have I heard tales of these Leagues, and the lengths mortals like you will go to for a shred of favour from a superior being.
** '''Yama:''' So now I offer you the same bargain that the 'mighty' Sage has struck time and time again. However, I present you with the chance of {{Colour|#000080|true}} power.
** '''Player:''' True power, eh?
** '''Yama:''' Does that intrigue you?
** '''Player:''' Of course! Who wouldn't be interested in that?
** '''Yama:''' Very good. In that case, complete the tasks you have been presented with and we can arrange some appropriate enhancements.
** '''Player:''' Alright!
** '''Yama:''' The League awaits you. Impress me.
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|What have you done to the Sage?}}
** '''Player:''' Why have you imprisoned the Sage? They're usually quite pleasant.
** '''Yama:''' I have seized the Sage just as I have claimed this League.
** '''Yama:''' The Sage has well and truly earned their place in my domain. Such squandered potential...
** '''Yama:''' More than that, do you understand what this League actually is? Where we are?
** '''Player:''' Erm... Yes?
** '''Yama:''' Hah! You do not. Nor did I before lengthy discussions with my guest.
** '''Yama:''' It is enough to say that I require guarantees for the near future.
** '''Player:''' What does that mean? Should I be concerned?
** '''Yama:''' You are small. When the time comes you will slip through the net and leave this chapter without incident.
